title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L284 Using a future VirtualClientOperationType is conditioned on all...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Generating Virtual Client Secrets. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L284.

Text: "expanded leaves; they are only usable from emulation-group epochs onward in
which all emulator clients derive them at expansion time."

Problem: Using a future VirtualClientOperationType is conditioned on all emulator clients deriving it, but no capability or GroupContext data signals when that holds. A sender cannot know whether peers can reproduce its LeafNode.

Suggested fix: Tie new operation types to an emulation-group capability or GroupContext field that changes only by Commit, or state that the set is fixed for this version.

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (The quoted text is at L284, not L281. The draft already acknowledges the limitation at L281-285. The defensible core is that the condition 'all emulator clients derive them' gives no way to know when it holds. Open PR #30 only rewords the line ('derivation epochs').)
